title: At the Max mesh, wall contours still turn into a sawtooth while the principal surface plays
detail:
Round 3 fixes the moving walls at the default mesh only. Above 256 cells (Fine, Ultra, Max), the principal surface gets no fill-in while moving, and its base cells use the lite program `land`, which has no facetW. So a wall that has moved past the levels still gets F at the fragment on a facet at the wrong height. That is round 2's sawtooth, unchanged. AS-BUILT lists this as 'Open: not measured'. Measured here:
- The user's case (sin √z, √ bracketed, Im, principal), desktop 1440x900, Max, Im H_t = 0 contour on the left wall at t = 0.2, with r3's measure (box 256,266 to 288,292, rest fit, largest deviation). Rest 0.48 px, moving 2.91 px, light and dark. Round 2's build, same stepping: 2.91 px, identical.
- The same at the default mesh: 0.50 against 0.50, fixed. All sheets at Max: 0.33 px (round 2: 3.23), fixed, because landSheet has facetW.
- Real play at 1x, frames captured mid-play: zigzag Im H_t = 0 and -0.5 contours on the salmon and teal walls at t ≈ 0.07, 0.15 and 0.28 (light) and t ≈ 0.10 and 0.25 (dark). The Max mesh is the quality setting, so this is where the user looks for article-grade walls. The base at Max is far worse (jagged grey curtains), so this is not a regression against the base. It still falls short of the request: continuous walls with clean contours.
- Phone 390x844, Max, principal, moving path: a short scratch on the teal wall's contour.
- The 1x and 2x real play at the default mesh is clean (principal and All sheets). r3's gate steps T by 0.006 a frame, but real play moves about 0.013 a frame at 1x and 0.026 at 2x. So the gate is softer than real motion and has no Max case.
evidence: notes/landscape-walls/r3/review-pictures/max-principal-play-light.png (top: r3 real play t ≈ 0.07, 0.15, 0.28; bottom: forced rest, forced moving, round 2 forced moving at t = 0.2); max-dark-2x-base.png (top left and middle: default mesh at 2x play, clean; top right and bottom left: Max dark real play; bottom middle and right: base at Max); max-principal-forced-t0.08.png; max-phone-forced-t0.2.png; measures.txt (line deviations). Raw frames: work/xvls/test/pictrev_cdp/shots/r3-user-max-desk-{light,dark}-play*.png, fm-r3-princ-max-*-t0.2-{rest,move}.png. Commands: review-pictures/cmd/fm.js, fm1.js, b1.js, b3.js.
fix: While moving at M > 256, draw the wall band with the refined program: list the cells at level 2 or more from the last read, plus one cell either side across the wall, at level 0. That uses the same corners and adds no evaluations, only a program switch, so facetW applies. Or use a facetW variant of `land` (`landF`), compiled after the first draw and taken into use once settled, like landSheetRF, so the cold open is not touched. Then extend the motion gate: a Max case, T steps of 0.013 and 0.026 a frame, light and dark.

title: A column of light speckles along a near edge-on wall in one real-play frame (sec z Re, default mesh)
detail: sec z, Re, default mesh, desktop light, the deformation playing at 1x. In the frame captured around t ≈ 0.38 (T moved 0.16 to 0.38 across the capture), the right silhouette of the purple strip on the left crest has a 2 to 3 px wide column of grey and white dots, over about 50 px of height. The neighbouring frames (t ≈ 0.16 and 0.61) do not have it. Neither do the rest frame or the forced moving path (GLR._lw.motion) at T = 0.38, which are clean, and the same as round 2's rest. So it is a transient of real play, most likely a frame whose levels came late on a near edge-on facet. Its cause was not isolated: the exact T of the frame is uncertain within 0.16 to 0.38. Seen once in this run, not reproduced.
evidence: notes/landscape-walls/r3/review-pictures/sec-play-speckle.png (7x: play1 with the speckled edge, play0 and play2 next to it); sec-t0.38-rest-move-r2-base.png (2.5x: rest, forced moving, round 2 rest, base rest at T = 0.38, all clean except the base). Raw: work/xvls/test/pictrev_cdp/shots/r3-sec-def-desk-light-play1.png.
fix: Re-capture sec z Re and tan z Re in real play with T read per frame (several runs) to pin the t. If it repeats, check the arg-line widths on near edge-on facets in frames where the levels came late. The width takes min(argWidth(w), argWidth(w0)), and on a silhouette that can make sub-pixel lines alias into dots. Fade the lines on facets seen edge-on (small |n·v|), or take the larger width there.

title: z^{1/5} tan 3z: with the deformation transport open, All sheets stays ticked but only the principal sheet is drawn (pre-existing)
detail: Custom z^{1/5} tan 3z, Re, All sheets ticked. Without the transport, all 5 sheets are drawn (GLR.landRefine: K = 5), and the comb walls are as clean as round 2's, far cleaner than the base. With the deformation transport open (range f1, t = 1), only one surface is drawn. The title reads 'landscape of Re H_t' with no 'all sheets', while the checkbox stays ticked. Round 2 and the base do the same, so this is not a round-3 regression. The user's case (a √ step) does draw its sheets while deforming. A ticked box that changes nothing reads as a broken switch at article grade.
evidence: notes/landscape-walls/r3/review-pictures/z15tan-allsheets-transport.png (top: no transport, this build, round 2, base; bottom: transport open, same order); z15tan-comb-r3-r2-base.png. Command: review-pictures/cmd/z15.js.
fix: Out of scope for the walls. Either support All sheets for a custom formula's deformation, or dim the checkbox with a short note while it has no effect.

title: Checked and clean: default-mesh motion, All sheets at Max, orbit, undersides, the tint near t = 0, phone
detail:
Frames captured mid-play (12 per run, t read from the transport) and mid-orbit (yaw turned every frame), headless Chrome with ANGLE Metal, desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844, light and dark:
- The user's case at the default mesh, All sheets on and off, 1x and 2x play, t ≈ 0.02 to 0.3: wall contours straight, no scratches, sawtooth or speckles. Forced moving path against rest at t = 0.08, 0.2 and 0.26: 12 to 253 pixels differ by more than 40 (a thin edge-on sliver at t = 0.26), and the left-wall contour is 0.50 against 0.50 px.
- All sheets at Max, desktop and phone: clean while playing (0.33 px).
- Mid-orbit at the default and Max meshes: clean. The mesh built at rest stays.
- Undersides from below (pitch negated) at t = 0.05 and while playing: coloured, light and dark.
- Tint at t = 0.03 and 0.05, cue off against on: 12.8 k to 20.4 k pixels change by more than 40 RGB on desktop, 3.9 k to 6.8 k on phone. The doubled walls read as a lighter and a darker copy in light and dark.
- tan z Re, sec z Re, log log z (All sheets, Im), e^{1/z} Re and z^{1/5} tan 3z (All sheets, no transport): at rest the same as round 2 and much cleaner than the base. While playing and orbiting there are no scratches, apart from pictures-1 at Max and pictures-2. The e^{1/z} tower top keeps round 2's thin rainbow strip (known low).
- No console errors or warnings in any run.
- Phone 390x844, Max, All sheets, playing: 60 fps, p95 18.5 and 18.6 ms. The base, alternating: 50 and 57 fps, p95 24.4 and 18.9.
evidence: notes/landscape-walls/r3/review-pictures/max-allsheets-play-clean.png, phone-allsheets-play-clean.png, max-orbit-clean.png, undersides-play.png, cue-t0.05-off-on.png, measures.txt. Raw frames: work/xvls/test/pictrev_cdp/shots/ (r3-*, fm-*, cue-*, under-*). Commands: review-pictures/cmd/.
